blocks.text: SINGAPORE – As the worst haze since 2015 enshrouds Singapore, runners have turned to running inside malls, yoga and other indoor exercise routines, and families are heading towards indoor playgrounds. Loy Suan Sheng Elmer, who usually runs outdoors up to six times a week, did not have any of his regular sessions for more than a week from Oct 9, due to the worsening air quality. Instead, the insurance manager could run only on a treadmill. On the morning of Oct 17, he joined X-Run Singapore, an indoor event at Marina Square mall where about 15 fitness enthusiasts ran laps within […]...
